key_decisions.rationale: Keeps necessity, lack of benefit, and topic shift.
key_decisions.before: It is necessary to boast, though there is nothing to be gained. I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.
key_decisions.after: I must boast. It is not beneficial, but I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is necessary to boast, though there is nothing to be gained. I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves third-person restraint, exact time, uncertainty, and repetition.
key_decisions.before: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or out of the body I do not know, God knows—was caught up to the third heaven.
key_decisions.after: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven—whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know; God knows.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or out of the body I do not know, God knows—was caught up to the third heaven.

key_decisions.before: I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows—
key_decisions.after: And I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know; God knows—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves paradise, unheard speech, and prohibition.
key_decisions.before: was caught up into paradise and heard inexpressible words, which it is not permitted for a person to speak.
key_decisions.after: was caught up into paradise and heard inexpressible words that a human is not permitted to speak.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: was caught up into paradise and heard inexpressible words, which it is not permitted for a person to speak.

key_decisions.before: For if I should wish to boast, I would not be foolish, for I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so that no one may think more of me than what he sees in me or hears from me.
key_decisions.after: For if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking truth. But I refrain, so that no one will credit me with more than what is seen in me or heard from me,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if I should wish to boast, I would not be foolish, for I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so that no one may think more of me than what he sees in me or hears from me.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps cause ambiguity, thorn, Satanic messenger, violence, and repetition.
key_decisions.before: And because of the surpassing greatness of the revelations, therefore, so that I might not be exalted beyond measure, a thorn was given to me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to strike me, so that I might not be exalted beyond measure.
key_decisions.after: even because of the extraordinary revelations. Therefore, so that I would not become conceited, a thorn was given to me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to strike me, so that I would not become conceited.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And because of the surpassing greatness of the revelations, therefore, so that I might not be exalted beyond measure, a thorn was given to me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to strike me, so that I might not be exalted beyond measure.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps direct answer, paradox, and tenting image.
key_decisions.before: And he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for power is brought to completion in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
key_decisions.after: But he said to me, “My grace is enough for you, for power is brought to completion in weakness.” Therefore I will most gladly boast all the more in my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may dwell over me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for power is brought to completion in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains real harms, reason, and paradox.
key_decisions.before: So I am content with weaknesses, with insults, with hardships, with persecutions, and with distresses, for the sake of Christ. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
key_decisions.after: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and distress for Christ, for whenever I am weak, then I am strong.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I am content with weaknesses, with insults, with hardships, with persecutions, and with distresses, for the sake of Christ. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps blame, expected defense, irony, and self-negation.
key_decisions.before: I have become foolish—you compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you. For I was in no way inferior to the super-apostles, even if I am nothing.
key_decisions.after: I have become a fool; you forced me to it. For I ought to have been recommended by you, because I was in no way inferior to the “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I have become foolish—you compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you. For I was in no way inferior to the super-apostles, even if I am nothing.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves passive action, endurance, and three manifestations.
key_decisions.before: The signs of an apostle were performed among you with all endurance, with signs and wonders and works of power.
key_decisions.after: The signs of an apostle were performed among you with all endurance, by signs, wonders, and miracles.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The signs of an apostle were performed among you with all endurance, with signs and wonders and works of power.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the rhetorical comparison and biting apology.
key_decisions.before: For in what were you treated as inferior to the other churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong.
key_decisions.after: In what way were you treated as less than the other churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For in what were you treated as inferior to the other churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves visit count, financial claim, and parental analogy.
key_decisions.before: Here for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be a burden, for I seek not what is yours but you. For children ought not to store up for the parents, but parents for the children.
key_decisions.after: Look, I am ready to come to you this third time, and I will not burden you, because I seek not what you own, but you. For children should not save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Here for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be a burden, for I seek not what is yours but you. For children ought not to store up for the parents, but parents for the children.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps financial/person metaphor and painful question.
key_decisions.before: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
key_decisions.after: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your lives. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves voiced accusation as an ironic question.
key_decisions.before: But be that as it may, I did not burden you. Yet, being crafty, I caught you by deceit.
key_decisions.after: But let it be so: I did not burden you. Yet, being crafty, did I catch you by deceit?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But be that as it may, I did not burden you. Yet, being crafty, I caught you by deceit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps rhetorical question, divine audience, affection, and purpose.

key_decisions.after: Have you been thinking all along that we are defending ourselves to you? We speak before God in Christ, and everything, beloved, is for building you up.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Have you been thinking all along that we are defending ourselves to you? It is before God that we speak in Christ, and all for your building up, beloved.
